name: discord-bot
description: Put your agents on Discord as themselves: they answer @mentions, DMs and threads with their own memory and tools (a routine wakes them), join voice calls, and can read channels, post, reply, react and start threads.

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.title: Discord bot token
DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: From https://discord.com/developers/applications → your application → Bot → Reset Token. Also turn on Message Content Intent on that page.

XAI_API_KEY.title: xAI API key (instant replies only)
XAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. From https://console.x.ai → API Keys. Only used when REPLY_MODE is instant. Voice calls use ElevenLabs instead.

ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.title: ElevenLabs API key (voice calls)
ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.description: Optional. From https://elevenlabs.io → API keys. Needed for /join and join_voice_channel. The hosted bot reads this from the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY secret.

ELEVENLABS_AGENT_ID.title: ElevenLabs agent id (optional)
ELEVENLABS_AGENT_ID.description: Existing ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent to use for voice. Leave empty and the bot creates or reuses an agent named grok-bot-discord and attaches the ask_agent client tool.

ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID.title: ElevenLabs voice id (optional)
ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID.description: Voice for calls. Applied as a per-call override when the agent allows it.

REPLY_MODE.title: Who answers messages
REPLY_MODE.description: agent (default): messages wait in an inbox and your agent answers them with its own memory and tools, woken by a routine every few minutes. instant: Grok answers within seconds with a persona you set, without your agent's memory (needs XAI_API_KEY).

ROUTINE_WEBHOOK_URL.title: Wake-up routine webhook URL (optional)
ROUTINE_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Create a routine on your Bot with the trigger "When a webhook fires" and the task "Run the discord-inbox skill", then paste its Webhook URL here so Discord messages wake your agent within seconds. You can also just ask your Bot to run the discord-setup skill.

DISCORD_DEFAULT_CHANNEL_ID.title: Default channel ID (optional)
DISCORD_DEFAULT_CHANNEL_ID.description: Channel the agent posts to when you don't name one. In Discord, turn on Developer Mode, then right-click a channel → Copy Channel ID.

ALLOWED_IDS.title: Who can talk to the bot (optional)
ALLOWED_IDS.description: Comma-separated Discord user or role IDs. Leave empty to let everyone who can see the bot use it (replies use your xAI credits).

ALLOWED_CHANNEL_IDS.title: Allowed channels (optional)
ALLOWED_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated channel IDs the bot works in; it ignores other server channels (threads count by their parent channel). Leave empty for all channels. DMs aren't affected.

LISTEN_CHANNEL_IDS.title: Always-reply channels (optional)
LISTEN_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated channel IDs where the bot answers every message, not only @mentions.
